@graph.name: full-V1-Breast-Cancer-Block-A-Section-1-workflow
@graph.description:
Main pipeline retains original SpatialData/Scanpy/Squidpy/CellTypist/LIANA outputs; unneeded upper spot filters and redundant gene min_counts=3 are removed. Independent Galaxy Inspect AnnData + Query Tabular evidence outputs: QC before/after filtering; PCA and regressed-PCA total-count correlations; Leiden sizes, adjusted Rand indices, and two resolution crosswalks; CellTypist label frequencies, confidences, and Leiden-label cross-tabulations. Existing Scanpy-ranked gene TSV retained. No arbitrary AnnData uns exporters added; LIANA/Squidpy uns values and modularity/silhouette remain outside evidence coverage. Local SQL verified against historical LIANA h5ad. Galaxy import and jobs: NOT TESTED.

## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Spatial transcriptomics analysis of the breast cancer tumour microenvironment with Visium](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/single-cell/tutorials/spatial-breast-cancer-tme-SPICA/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)
